trace.reasoning: Let's analyze the conditions one by one and see if we can determine the publication years of each book. We have the following conditions to satisfy: 1) The poetry collection was published exactly 5 years after the biography. 2) The novel was published before any of the other four books. 3) The essay collection was published after the memoir. Let's start with the novel. Since the novel was published before any of the other four books, it must be the earliest publication. The earliest year available is 2001. So, the novel was published in 2001. Now, let's consider the poetry collection. It was published exactly 5 years after the biography. The only possible years for the biography are 2004, 2009, 2013, and 2020. If the novel is in 2001, the biography must be in 2006 (2001 + 5). The essay collection was published after the memoir. So, the memoir must be in one of the earlier years, and the essay collection must be in one of the later years. The memoir can be in 2004 or 2009, and the essay collection must be in 2013 or 2020. Given the conditions, the only way to satisfy all conditions is if the memoir is in 2004 and the essay collection is in 2013. This leaves the novel (2001) and the poetry collection (2006) to be the last two. The only way to satisfy the poetry collection being 5 years after the biography is if the poetry collection is in 2011. This leaves 2020 for the novel. Therefore, the solution is: Novel: 2001, Biography: 2006, Poetry: 2011, Essays: 2013, Memoir: 2004. This solution is unique.
